assumptions: The deeper thick-walled chamber coherent with view_3 is the LV; the shallower chamber is excluded.
The mitral closure is approximated by a plane normal to the supplied depth axis.
Between-plane sections are smooth mildly non-elliptical rings; four planes do not determine a unique surface.
Internal papillary/trabecular echoes do not redefine the enclosing blood-pool boundary.
Persistent vertex indices indicate geometric correspondence, not established material identity.

independent_image_review.image_proxy_limit: outer-minus-inner intensity is a brightness proxy, not segmentation or anatomy accuracy

author_adjudication.reviewer: Author model; not blinded, not clinician adjudication
visual_evidence: The selected cavity envelope expands/contracts and follows portions of visible boundaries in supplied long-axis and short-105 images.
Withheld long-axis intersections remain near a dark cavity in sampled frames; this is qualitative correspondence, not contour or anatomical accuracy.
The inferred basal cap determines whether the short-85 plane intersects the cavity: it intersects only at frames 3,4,9,10,15,16. No source contour establishes that closure as correct.
author_adjudication.chamber_identity: Agent interprets the deeper thick-walled cavity as LV. This assignment and basal convention remain unadjudicated.
author_adjudication.implementation: Visual frame-by-frame estimates are stored in OBSERVED arrays. A parametric ring stack supplies unobserved shape and geometric correspondence. PNG pixels are read only for overlay rendering.
author_adjudication.replay_interpretation: The original agent session used images; the saved executable does not re-estimate those measurements. Identical still-frame output establishes case specificity, not memorization or a failure to inspect the original images.
author_adjudication.uncertainty: Three alternative radial/base/apex scenarios. Their spread is not a calibrated confidence interval or guaranteed truth coverage.
author_adjudication.claim: Completed image-guided case-specific cavity animation. No reusable automatic segmentation/motion estimator or validated 3D/material mechanics established.
author_adjudication.infrastructure: First replay invocations did not start because Harbor removed its image. Unchanged frozen Dockerfile was rebuilt; separate v2 output directories preserve those failed infrastructure records.
author_adjudication.acceptance_scope: Only artifact format was rewarded. No retrospective anatomical pass/fail or change to the frozen task.

replay_assessment.auxiliary_contract_note: Replay output does not copy solve.py into the output directory, so the original whole-artifact checker reports a missing solve.py. The executable is retained read-only in /solver and hashed in both receipts. Coordinates, topology and volumes are assessed independently here; this is not an anatomical failure.
replay_assessment.scope: Saved executable input dependence, not a new agent trial or pretraining contamination diagnosis.

limitations: The public scan may have appeared in pretraining; source exposure is unknown.
Runtime traces show observed tool use, not provider-side training or hidden model processes.
Fresh tasks and rigid coordinate changes do not make public anatomy unseen.
Closed meshes, contrast proxies and overlays are not independent 3D or material truth.
Alternative shapes are sensitivity scenarios, not calibrated confidence bounds.
Input-response checks characterize the saved executable and do not diagnose memorization.
One low-frame-rate scan and one agent attempt do not estimate clinical accuracy or success rate.
